احتوشا (form VIII)
# اِحْتَوَشَا (iḥtawašā) /iħ.ta.wa.ʃaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِحْتَوَشَ (iḥtawaša)
# اُحْتُوِشَا (uḥtuwišā) /uħ.tu.wi.ʃaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِحْتَوَشَ (iḥtawaša)
# اِحْتَوِشَا (iḥtawišā) /iħ.ta.wi.ʃaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِحْتَوَشَ (iḥtawaša)
